scholarships.title: ADB-Japan Scholarship Program (JSP)
scholarships.official_source: Asian Development Bank (financed by the Government of Japan)

existing.description: The ADB-Japan Scholarship Program awards about 135 graduate scholarships a year for study in economics, business and management, science and technology and other development-related fields at 27 designated institutions in Asia and the Pacific, 17 of which are in Japan. The Japanese Government finances the programme and ADB administers it, including selecting awardees. Applicants apply directly to a designated institution, which screens and ranks them before ADB reviews the list and recommends awardees to the Executive Director of Japan for formal approval.
existing.application_period: Rolling, institution-led: ADB instructs applicants to send applications at least six months prior to the planned commencement of studies, so a 2027 start can be applied for now
existing.deadline_display: No single ADB deadline; applications go to a designated institution at least six months before the intended start of studies
existing.program_type: Multilateral scholarship financed by the Government of Japan and administered by the Asian Development Bank
